episodes.synopsis: Now officially a couple, Kazehaya and Sawako go on their first real date. Over summer vacation, Sawako asks Chizu and Ayane for relationship advice.
episodes.title: There's No Way I Would Hate You

episodes.synopsis: With the class trip coming up, another boy approaches Ayane. When the students arrive in Okinawa, the new atmosphere causes big changes in everyone.
episodes.title: School Trip

episodes.synopsis: Sawako feels like Kazehaya is keeping his distance. After connecting with Ryu on the trip, Chizu tells her friends about her memories with him.
episodes.title: Girlfriend and Boyfriend

episodes.synopsis: Though Sawako is excited about celebrating Christmas with Kazehaya and her friends, everyone is preoccupied with their own romantic problems.
episodes.title: Christmas Party

episodes.synopsis: After his teacher gives him some advice, Kazehaya finally talks to Sawako on their way home. The next day, everyone gathers at Sawako's house.
episodes.title: Happy Moment
